criteria.text: measureProposal(proposal) computes the per-kind metric: tighten-scope/prune-scope: keep iff scope-hygiene strictly improves AND the functional guard passes (no tool/server that was actually exercised in the trailing window was removed). Revert otherwise.

measureProposal(proposal) computes the per-kind metric: refine-skill/consolidate-skill/refine-recipe: keep iff post > baseline via the reused LLM scorer (injectable in tests). Revert on tie/error (fail-closed).
criteria.test_id: issue-821-c3c: refine-skill keep iff post>baseline via injected scorer; ties revert

criteria.text: Revert replays before_snapshot_json, restores the prior state, and sets status='reverted'; a reverted proposal is added to the dedup seen-set so it is not re-proposed.
